import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 3, figsize=(18, 15))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], s=df['Physical Activity Level']*2,
                             cmap='RdYlBu_r', alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep\n(Color: Stress Level, Size: Physical Activity)')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level')

# 2. Daily Steps by Occupation
occupation_data = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({'Daily Steps': 'mean', 'Person ID': 'count'}).reset_index()
bars = axes[0, 1].bar(occupation_data['Occupation'], occupation_data['Daily Steps'], 
                      color=['skyblue', 'lightgreen', 'salmon'])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Average Daily Steps')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Average Daily Steps by Occupation')
axes[0, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add count labels on bars
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, occupation_data['Person ID'])):
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[0, 1].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 100,
                   f'n={count}', ha='center', va='bottom')

# 3. Physical Activity vs Stress Level
for bmi_category in df['BMI Category'].unique():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi_category]
    axes[0, 2].scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Stress Level'],
                      label=bmi_category, s=100, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Stress Level')
axes[0, 2].set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress Level by BMI Category')
axes[0, 2].legend()
axes[0, 2].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Heart Rate Distribution by BMI Category
bmi_colors = {'Normal': 'lightgreen', 'Overweight': 'orange', 'Obese': 'salmon'}
for bmi_category, color in bmi_colors.items():
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi_category]
    if len(subset) > 0:
        axes[1, 0].hist(subset['Heart Rate'], alpha=0.7, label=bmi_category,
                       color=color, bins=5, edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by BMI Category')
axes[1, 0].legend()

# 5. Sleep Metrics Comparison
sleep_metrics = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep']
x_pos = np.arange(len(sleep_metrics))
width = 0.25

for i, occupation in enumerate(df['Occupation'].unique()):
    subset = df[df['Occupation'] == occupation]
    if len(subset) > 0:
        values = [subset['Sleep Duration'].mean(), subset['Quality of Sleep'].mean()]
        axes[1, 1].bar(x_pos + i*width, values, width, label=occupation, alpha=0.7)

axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Metric')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Value')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sleep Metrics Comparison by Occupation')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(x_pos + width)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(sleep_metrics)
axes[1, 1].legend()

# 6. Correlation Heatmap
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level',
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
im = axes[1, 2].imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
axes[1, 2].set_xticks(range(len(numeric_cols)))
axes[1, 2].set_yticks(range(len(numeric_cols)))
axes[1, 2].set_xticklabels(numeric_cols, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[1, 2].set_yticklabels(numeric_cols)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Numeric Features')

# Add correlation values
for i in range(len(numeric_cols)):
    for j in range(len(numeric_cols)):
        text = axes[1, 2].text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                              ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=8)

# 7. BMI Category Distribution
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[2, 0].pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index,
                                          autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90,
                                          colors=[bmi_colors[cat] for cat in bmi_counts.index])
axes[2, 0].set_title('BMI Category Distribution')

# 8. Age vs Heart Rate with Sleep Disorder
has_disorder = df['Sleep Disorder'] != ''
axes[2, 1].scatter(df.loc[~has_disorder, 'Age'], df.loc[~has_disorder, 'Heart Rate'],
                   color='blue', label='No Disorder', s=100, alpha=0.7)
axes[2, 1].scatter(df.loc[has_disorder, 'Age'], df.loc[has_disorder, 'Heart Rate'],
                   color='red', label='Sleep Apnea', s=150, alpha=0.7, marker='s')
axes[2, 1].set_xlabel('Age')
axes[2, 1].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
axes[2, 1].set_title('Age vs Heart Rate (with Sleep Disorder Status)')
axes[2, 1].legend()
axes[2, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 9. Summary Statistics Table
summary_stats = df[numeric_cols].describe().round(2)
cell_text = []
for row in summary_stats.values:
    cell_text.append([f'{x:.2f}' for x in row])

axes[2, 2].axis('tight')
axes[2, 2].axis('off')
table = axes[2, 2].table(cellText=cell_text,
                         rowLabels=summary_stats.index,
                         colLabels=summary_stats.columns,
                         cellLoc='center',
                         loc='center',
                         colWidths=[0.15]*len(numeric_cols))
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(8)
table.scale(1, 1.5)
axes[2, 2].set_title('Summary Statistics', pad=20)
